name: Marla's Last Wish
summary: In Deathknell, Marla's Last Wish calls you to bring a husband and wife together in death. Novice Elreth asks you to find Samuel Fipps, still bound to the Scourge, so he can be buried beside his wife, Marla. The Forsaken seek to honor the ties they had in life and to set themselves apart from the Scourge.

sections.title: A Tragic Reunion
sections.body: Marla and Samuel Fipps were husband and wife in Lordaeron before the Third War devastated their home. When the plague swept through their lands, Samuel succumbed and rose as a mindless thrall of the Scourge. Marla escaped undeath, but not her husband. In his frenzy, Samuel killed her. Even then, Marla bore him no hatred. Novice Elreth remembers her final wish: to rest beside Samuel in the Deathknell graveyard.

sections.title: Respecting the Dead
sections.body: Novice Elreth sends you northeast of Deathknell to find Samuel Fipps, who still wanders among a ruined campsite. Ending his torment would remove a Scourge minion from the valley and let his remains be carried back to Marla's resting place. Elreth believes that honoring the dead and their final wishes sets the newly freed Forsaken apart from the Scourge.

faq.answer: Marla Fipps lived in Lordaeron and survived the plague, but her husband Samuel killed her after he became a mindless Scourge thrall. She wished to be laid to rest beside him.

Samuel Fipps was Marla's husband before the plague. He fell to the Scourge and lost his mind, then killed Marla. He wanders a ruined campsite northeast of Deathknell until Forsaken adventurers put an end to his torment.

faq.q: Why does Novice Elreth care about burying them together?
faq.answer: Novice Elreth was Marla's friend in life. Elreth believes honoring the dead and treating their remains with dignity shows that the Forsaken retain their humanity and morality, unlike the mindless Scourge.
No. Novice Elreth says Marla was spared undeath. Samuel killed her while she was still mortal, and she was buried in the Deathknell graveyard.
Marla's grave is in the first row of the cemetery just outside Deathknell's main chapel.

faq.q: Where can Samuel Fipps be found?
faq.answer: Samuel Fipps wanders around a ruined campsite along the road northeast of Deathknell.

angles.text: As a newly risen Forsaken, fulfilling Marla's wish can anchor you to your former human life and show that compassion and honor survived Lordaeron's fall.
As a Forsaken priest, Novice Elreth's insistence on proper burial rites speaks to your spiritual duty amid mortality, grief, and the desecration of Lordaeron's dead.
